player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Puorguojīņam juobyut [macro micro] formā ar ciparim 0-8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Mikro_bolva, rynds voi kolns nav diapazonā.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: The player must play in the next micro board.

game_action.played: Spēletajs {player_id} spēlēja mikroplāksnē {macro_idx}, šūnā {micro_idx} (rinda {row}, kolonna {col}). Spēletajam {opponent_id} jāspēlē tagad {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Spālātuojs {player_id} uzvar Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
